rounds_detail.headline: Retail Call Sweep Sparks Early Momentum
rounds_detail.market_event: Aggressive retail call buying initiates order flow imbalance as short sellers resist.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Accumulating modest volume near the 20-day SMA while monitoring retail option sweeps.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Providing liquidity against incoming ask sweeps while expanding spread bands.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Breakout above $224 triggers social media sentiment pump and aggressive call buying.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Fading initial retail enthusiasm near local resistance levels.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Cleared net buy imbalance of +1,500 shares, adjusting spot price up to $225.20 via Kyle's lambda.

rounds_detail.headline: Option Gamma Accelerates Upside Pressure
rounds_detail.market_event: Market makers buy delta to hedge short calls while retail buying intensifies.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Pausing execution to evaluate dynamic gamma exposure across major strike levels.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Laying off dynamic delta risk into rising bids as volatility expands.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Chasing the momentum candle as call volume explodes across near-term expiry strikes.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Adding to short position expecting RSI divergence to trigger mean-reversion.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Cleared net buy imbalance of +900 shares, shifting price to $227.15.

rounds_detail.headline: Short Margin Calls Trigger Initial Liquidations
rounds_detail.market_event: Rising price breaches key risk thresholds forcing shorts into market buy-backs.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Riding momentum spike as algorithmic models signal short-side stop cascade.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Widening ask quotes significantly to absorb extreme buy order flow.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Maximum FOMO achieved as short squeeze narrative goes viral across trading forums.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Forced risk management buy-stop triggered as price breaches key stop-loss zone.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Massive +6,500 share net buy imbalance cleared, causing a steep jump to $234.90.

rounds_detail.headline: Full-Scale Short Squeeze Cascade
rounds_detail.market_event: Involuntary buy-ins combined with peak retail demand drive exponential price movement.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Initiating scale-out profit taking into hyper-extended liquidity liquidity pools.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Utilizing circuit-breaker level spreads to manage directional exposure.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Market buying blindly as stock crosses $240 in parabolic fashion.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Complete capitulation and forced liquidation of remaining short inventory.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Heavy imbalance of +5,000 shares processed, pushing price to $242.80 under 2.0x volatility multiplier.

rounds_detail.headline: Blow-Off Peak & Smart Money Distribution
rounds_detail.market_event: Smart money unloads large blocks into waning squeeze demand.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Aggressive distribution into extreme overbought RSI conditions above 75.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Shorting excess delta at elevated prices to restore neutral balance.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Buying late-stage calls expecting relentless continuation towards $250.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Clearing residual hedge liabilities as margin calls reach completion.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Net buy imbalance slows to +1,000 shares, nudging clearing price to $245.30.

rounds_detail.headline: Buying Exhaustion & Shift in Flow
rounds_detail.market_event: Retail momentum flags while institutional selling flips the order book net negative.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Executing major profit taking block trade as retail volume tapers off.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Absorbing sell orders to stabilize rapidly moving bid-ask spread.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Buying the initial dip under belief that the rally has further momentum.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Initiating fresh short positions on clear signs of momentum exhaustion.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: First net sell imbalance (-1,500 shares) forces market clearing price down to $242.10.

rounds_detail.headline: Profit-Taking Cascade & Mean Reversion
rounds_detail.market_event: Heavy sell-side pressure accelerates as retail panic-sells long calls.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Unwinding remaining tactically bought shares into secondary liquidity.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Buying inventory discount to balance order book as gamma unwind accelerates.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Panic cutting losses on rapidly depreciating short-dated call contracts.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Pressing new short position aggressively into post-squeeze technical breakdown.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Large net sell imbalance (-5,000 shares) resets price downward to $234.50.

rounds_detail.headline: Post-Squeeze Equilibrium & Settlement
rounds_detail.market_event: Order flow normalizes around elevated value area above pre-squeeze levels.

Institutional Smart Money.thesis: Re-establishing long-term core position at higher fundamental baseline.

Market Maker / HFT.thesis: Tightening spreads as option volatility skews return to baseline standard deviation.

Retail Momentum / FOMO.thesis: Activity cools down following major intraday volatility expansion.

Contrarian Short-Seller.thesis: Maintaining tactical short exposure below overhead resistance.

Chief Risk Officer & Arbitrator.thesis: Session ends with slight +500 share net balance, establishing final equilibrium price at $235.60.
